pages.title: Getting Power
pages.text: The gray chalk is made with one of the magical pastes, making it an intermediate-level$(br) foundation chalk. Its magical properties can react in curious ways with the world around it.$(br)
As an enhanced foundation chalk, it further strengthens the core of the pentacle and$(br) (almost always) can replace white glyphs or light gray glyphs.$(br)

pages.title: Gray Paste
pages.text: This strange amorphous paste is mainly used to improve the foundation of your pentacles.$(br) But its secondary use can be very useful, some dusts react with portion of this matter$(br) and return to their original shape as before being crushed.$()

pages.title: Growing ores
pages.text: The property of interacting with dusts can be combined with the powers of the $(item)Nature Paste$(),$(br) holding the $(item)Gray Paste$() in the off-hand will allow you to interact with$(br) some minerals, making them grow and extracting extra resources from $()
